metaTitle: Custom Screen Print T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print t shirts in bulk. Perfect for teams, events, and giveaways. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Screen printing is the go-to decoration method for bulk t-shirt orders because it delivers bold, vibrant colors that last wash after wash. When you need hundreds or thousands of custom screen print t shirts for a company picnic, safety team, or marketing campaign, screen printing offers the best cost-per-shirt ratio. The ink sits on the fabric surface, creating a soft hand feel with excellent opacity on both light and dark garments. Choose plastisol or water-based inks depending on your fabric and design complexity.
